LDV Platform Core

LDV Platform is the shared Python foundation beneath the PETRO Reporting Interface. It provides domain logic, compliance checks, and intelligence capabilities — not a separate web application.

Core services

Schema compliance, PPDM Lite governance helpers, and shared utilities in ldv_platform/core/.

Domain products

Master data and contract domain modules in ldv_platform/domain_products/.

Compliance CLI

Run PPDM Lite schema compliance from the repo root:

python -m ldv_platform.run_compliance
